load_ply_mesh: load a 3D mesh model from a PLY file and return vertices, normals, colors, and faces
save_ply_mesh: save a 3D mesh model with vertices, normals, colors, and faces to a PLY file
load_bop_results: load 6D object pose estimates from a BOP results file and optionally filter by top N per image
save_bop_results: save 6D object pose estimates with scene ID, image ID, object ID, score, rotation, and translation to a file
load_scene_camera: load scene camera parameters from a JSON file and convert intrinsics and extrinsics to numpy arrays
